name: Takagi (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Takagi village emblem in white: an outlined lobed device enclosing the character 喬.
history: Municipal flag of Takagi, a village in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 February 1971.

features.role: Takagi village emblem — an outlined lobed device enclosing the character 喬
